projects.title: PankoApp
projects.description:
PankoApp is an open-source project that collects basic information while you use it, and returns statistics and recommendations based on calculated habits. Its aim is to increase productivity in a research-backed manner. The project also places an emphasis on streamlined usage with minimal clutter.

Features Google Cloud employment and continuous integration workflows.

projects.title: IntelliNote.io
projects.description: An online sheet music application that offers a diverse kit for musicians to experiment with music compositions, equipped with an intelligent audio converter. Has a fully functional, standalone social platform.
